notes: Meetings are Wednesdays 4 to 6 pm starting in February. You get yourself to meetings and the internship. Questions: DMBYLP@fairfaxcounty.gov or 703-324-4062. Page does not give the internship year; it is July 2027 for this class.
name: Fairfax County Youth Leadership Program (FCYLP)
org: Fairfax County Department of Management and Budget
what_you_do: Monthly sessions on local government. Then a three-week full-time internship in July in a Fairfax County department. Students also meet a member of the Board of Supervisors.
who_can_apply: You must be a junior now in a Fairfax County public school. You should be doing well in class. You should care about local government. You cannot also do the Governor School Program.
duration: Monthly meetings from Feb 2027 plus a 3-week internship in July (40 hours per week)
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027-2028 class are due 11:59 p.m. Sunday, Nov 8, 2026. Decisions emailed in mid-December.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Send one letter of support. It can come from a teacher, scout leader, boss or someone like that.
